verdict.rationale: The evidence shows several relevant control points. Integrations are added explicitly per server via `claude mcp add` (docs-35, docs-29). The Bash sandbox lets you define which files and network domains commands can reach, with OS enforcement (docs-50). Claude for Enterprise offers managed policy settings for organization-wide Claude Code configuration (docs-41). The Agent SDK advertises full control over tool access and permissions (docs-18). However, none of this directly documents a lead-level allowlist or denylist of MCP servers or tools for Claude Code itself. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of per-tool/MCP-server allow/deny permission rules, evidence that managed policies can restrict which integrations are allowed, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
